summary: Equinix Inc., through its subsidiary Equinix Canada Financing Ltd., filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) under Rule 424(b)(5) for an offering of C$ % Senior Notes due 20, fully and unconditionally guaranteed by Equinix Inc. The notes are unsecured senior obligations, redeemable at the issuer's option with a make-whole premium, and include a change-of-control put at 101% of principal plus accrued interest. No deal terms are publicly disclosed as the offering is still subject to completion. This is a routine debt issuance for financing purposes, not a special situation event.
